title.narrative: Provision of emergency cash-based transfers in the form of electronic food vouchers to vulnerable Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

description.narrative: WFP has been addressing the deteriorating food security in Palestine by providing food and cash assistance to extremely poor and food insecure. Cash-based transfers, in the form of electronic food vouchers, have been a primary method for assisting beneficiaries aiming to meet a share of their food needs. Under this proposal, WFP assists 140,000 people in both Gaza and the West Bank with Food Security activities in the form of electronic food vouchers.

description.narrative: The WFP food entitlements are distributed in a timely manner through accredited shops to targeted beneficiaries in the Gaza Strip. With this contribution, WFP will distribute cash-based transfers, usingelectronic food vouchers, to 105,000 severely food insecure people who have been also affected by the ongoing conflict, for a period of one month and a half. Every targeted beneficiary household will receive a monthly voucher entitlement of USD 12.40 per person, allowing them to meet around 60 percent of their daily calorie needs.The outcome will be measured by WFP Food Consumption Scores (FCS): percentage of households with acceptable FCS (baseline: 40; target: => 40)Note: The baseline and target values are estimated based on the ongoing deterioration in the situation in Gaza.
